jobs.title: FP&A Analyst - Incentive Compensation
jobs.description:
The FP\&A Analyst – Incentive Compensation will support the administration, financial management, and analysis of the company’s commission and incentive compensation programs. This role will help ensure incentive calculations and payouts are accurate, timely, well\-controlled, and aligned with approved plan terms and business objectives. The analyst will partner closely with Compensation, HR, Payroll, Sales, Operations, and Finance, and will also support broader FP\&A projects as needed.

  

* Reconcile incentive calculations to source data, plan terms, and financial results.
* Maintain employee eligibility, plan assignments, goals, rates, thresholds, and other compensation\-plan parameters.
* Analyze the performance and cost of existing commission and incentive plans, including attainment trends, payout distributions, and return on incentive investment.
* Partner with Compensation, HR, Payroll, Sales, Operations, and Finance to model proposed plan changes, quantify their financial, operational, and employee impact before and after implementation.
* Support forecasting, budgeting, accruals, and variance analysis for incentive compensation expense.
* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide visibility into plan performance, payout trends, and financial exposure.
* Establish and perform controls designed to identify data and calculation errors
* Maintain plan documentation, calculation methodologies, approval records, and other materials necessary to support a clear audit trail.
* Support the annual incentive\-plan design, implementation, testing, and communication process.
* Identify opportunities to automate calculations, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and streamline incentive compensation processes.
Participate in broader FP\&A analysis and system\-improvement initiatives as needed.  
* 

  

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* 2\+ years of experience in FP\&A, compensation analytics, financial analysis, sales operations, payroll analytics, or a related field.
* Strong Excel and financial\-modeling skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with careful attention to detail and accuracy.
* Working knowledge of accounting principles, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
* Ability to reconcile and validate information across multiple systems and large datasets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain compensation calculations and financial analysis clearly.
* Ability to manage recurring deadlines, confidential information, and multiple priorities with limited supervision.
* Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across Finance, HR, Payroll, Sales, and Operations.
* Experience with incentive compensation platforms, Power BI, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, or JD Edwards is preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

* The Sales and Marketing Compliance team is responsible for driving and maintaining internal and external compliance for the business as well as corporate policy as we continue to build and scale our company and culture. This team develops and executes external audits to ensure sales and marketing activities are in compliance with CMS guidelines and conducts investigations related to agent/agency activity.
* In this role, the Senior Compliance Analyst is responsible for the escalated and more complex agent and agency investigations related to sales and marketing, including recommending and assigning corrective actions. The Senior Compliance Analyst will train Devoted associates who join the compliance team during the high volume season and conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure compliancy standards are met. They will serve as a resource to other analysts on investigative approach, documentation standards and escalation decisions.
* This position will report to the Sales \& Marketing Compliance Manager.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Serve as a compliance investigator for escalated and complex case investigations, corrective action recommendations and remediation activities related to sales and marketing
* Communicate with both internal and external partners to drive results, keeping key stakeholders informed of case status, emerging risk and barriers to resolution
* Draft and update complex compliance policies, procedures and investigative job aids, and recommend changes based on trends observed across cases and audits
* Present case findings to an Agent Review Board in a clear and concise manner that allows for quick and objective decision making
* Serve as a subject matter resource to Compliance Analysts on investigative methodology, evidence standards, documentation quality and corrective action precedent
* Identify trends across cases and recommend process, training and system improvements that reduce investigation cycle time and pending case volume
* Partner with cross\-functional teams, including Sales, Sales Operations, Legal and Technology, to gather input, resolve issues and support enhancements to the investigative workflow system

***Required skills and experience:***

* Bachelor’s degree
* 2\+ years experience in a Medicare Advantage marketing, sales, or compliance role, including hands\-on experience conducting investigations
* Attention to detail, organized and thorough with a desire for continuous process improvements
* Self\-motivated with the ability to adapt to change quickly and strong ability to problem solve
* Takes initiative to organize work effectively and manage a high volume, mixed complexity caseload against defined turnaround times
* Ability to critically assess information from multiple sources, reach a defensible conclusion, and recognize when a matter needs to be escalated
* Demonstrated record of reliably delivering work and projects that meet defined objectives with limited day to day oversight

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Desire and flexibility to collaborate with co\-workers in a virtual environment as a team player
* Experience in conducting monitoring and auditing activities of TPMO’s

jobs.title: Program Analyst
jobs.description:
ERG is a research and consulting firm that provides a wide range of support to federal, state, and commercial clients. ERG offers multidisciplinary teams with nationally recognized skills in engineering, science, economics, public health, informational technology, and communications. We hire people with the best minds and then provide them with a vibrant and flexible environment in which to develop their careers. The qualified individual must be highly motivated with the skills to prioritize, perform, and communicate effectively in a fast\-paced environment.  

ERG is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Program Analyst to support budget tracking, data management, and operational coordination to support ERG’s federal government contracts. This position is essential in ensuring the accuracy of project financials, maintaining internal systems, and supporting teams in achieving operational excellence.


While preference will be given to candidates based in the DMV region, qualified candidates outside the area will be considered. Non\-local candidates must maintain availability during core working hours of 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET.


### **Job Description:**

* Generate, maintain, and update project expenditure databases, cost estimates, and financial projections
* Review and verify financial and project data for accuracy
* Conduct biweekly budget review meetings and prepare meeting documentation and reports
* Perform monthly updates for contract year spend
* Track project charging, contract spend, subcontract budgets, and team performance metrics
* Support marketing, business development, and proposal efforts
* Participate in and support process improvement meetings and initiatives
* Manage project documentation, communication tools, and collaboration platforms (Teams, SharePoint, M365\)
* Ensure accurate and timely updates to internal databases and communication tools

### **Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Project Management, or a related field
* Minimum GPA of 3\.0 (college transcripts required for applicants with less than 4 years of experience)
* 2\-4 years of experience in project coordination, budget tracking, or a similar operations role
* Proficiency in SharePoint, Teams, and M365 tools
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and fundamental data management concepts
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
* Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
* Team\-player with the flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and project needs
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience supporting federal government contracts or working in a technical/engineering organization is a plus
* Must currently hold or be able to obtain a DoD SECRET security clearance
* Must be a U.S. citizen, as this position is not eligible for Limited Access Authorizations
ERG offers competitive salaries and excellent benefits, including health and dental insurance, life insurance, long\-term disability, educational benefits, FSAs, a generous 401k plan, profit sharing, an EAP, 11\-20 paid vacation days per year, 10 paid holidays per year, 56 hours or more of sick leave (based on the state you work in) per year (pro\-rated for part\-time) and more. The salary range for all positions depends on the years and type of experience.
ERG is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable EEOC regulations. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual preference, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.
Please be aware, the only authentic corporate domain for ERG is https://www.erg.com. ERG may, on occasion, screen applicants via telephone or video interviews via Skype, Teams, GoToMeeting, or another type of video platform. However, any candidate extended a job offer might be asked to meet in person with an ERG employee before providing confidential personal information associated with new employment.
If you’re a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ERG’s online application process as a result of your disability. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources via email at Resumes\-Lex@erg.com or call (781\) 674\-7293\.
ERG fosters a friendly, flexible work environment. ERGers are dedicated to serving clients who are committed to making the world a better place. We promote and recognize principles of fairness and respect in the work we do, the partnerships we foster, and the culture we value both within and outside of our organization.

jobs.title: Aviation Program Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Crown Innovations, Inc. is a dynamic and growing organization providing professional services and operational support solutions to government and commercial customers nationwide. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.

 **Job Description** **Aviation Program Analyst**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.\-based)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Position Overview**


Crown Innovations is seeking a motivated Aviation Program Analyst to support a growing portfolio of state government, federal, and commercial aviation initiatives focused on Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), Advanced Air Mobility (AAM), airport electrification, and emerging aviation technologies.


This role is ideal for a professional with approximately 3\-4 years of experience in aviation, aerospace, transportation, UAS, AAM, airport planning, or a related field. The successful candidate will support program delivery, stakeholder engagement, research and analysis, technical writing, and implementation planning for innovative aviation programs across the United States.


The position provides the opportunity to work directly with state departments of transportation, airports, industry leaders, healthcare systems, utility companies, OEMs and operators of aviation systems, federal agencies, and emerging aviation technology companies helping shape the future of aviation. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting project execution, coordinating stakeholders, developing technical content, and helping clients solve problems through planning work and advisory for the implementation of emerging aviation technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Program and Project Support**
	+ Support the successful execution of aviation, UAS, AAM, and airport\-related projects and programs.
	+ Maintain project schedules, task trackers, action\-item logs, timelines, and project management tools.
	+ Coordinate activities among clients, internal team members, subject matter experts, and external stakeholders.
	+ Assist in the preparation of project status reports, progress updates, meeting summaries, and client communications.
	+ Track project milestones, deliverables, and project risks to help ensure on\-time project delivery.
	+ Support program implementation efforts and large\-scale aviation initiatives involving government and industry partners.
* **Research and Analysis**
	+ Conduct research on UAS, Advanced Air Mobility, airport electrification, emerging aviation technologies, and related policy developments.
	+ Track and analyze state, local, and federal initiatives supporting advanced aviation integration.
	+ Monitor programs such as FAA eIPP, BEYOND, SMART, and other emerging aviation initiatives.
	+ Support environmental, regulatory, operational, infrastructure, and economic analyses associated with aviation projects.
	+ Develop market assessments, implementation strategies, and industry research summaries.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**
	+ Coordinate outreach efforts with airports, government agencies, industry organizations, private companies, and community stakeholders.
	+ Develop interview guides, surveys, questionnaires, and stakeholder engagement materials.
	+ Conduct virtual and in\-person interviews with organizations evaluating UAS and AAM applications, including healthcare, utilities, infrastructure, logistics, emergency response, and construction sectors.
	+ Document findings and prepare recommendations, summaries, and implementation considerations.
* **Technical Writing and Communications**
	+ Draft technical reports, white papers, research papers, case studies, presentations, and briefing materials.
	+ Support the development of thought leadership content related to advanced aviation technologies and implementation strategies.
	+ Prepare client\-ready deliverables and executive\-level communications.
	+ Assist with proposal development, grant applications, and business growth initiatives.
* **Industry and Market Intelligence**
	+ Track airports, states, utilities, and industry organizations implementing UAS, AAM, and electrification initiatives.
	+ Monitor developments in FAA policy, industry trends, infrastructure investments, and technology adoption.
	+ Maintain awareness of key stakeholders, technology providers, operators, and emerging market opportunities across the advanced aviation ecosystem.
	+ Support development of GIS\-based analyses, mapping products, dashboards, and visualization tools to communicate aviation infrastructure, UAS, AAM, and airport planning information to clients and stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Aerospace, Transportation Planning, or a related field.
* Approximately 3\-5 years of professional experience supporting aviation, aerospace, transportation, airport planning, UAS, AAM, or related consulting and infrastructure projects.
* Working knowledge of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), Advanced Air Mobility (AAM), airport operations, aviation planning, or emerging aviation technologies.
* Experience supporting project delivery, stakeholder coordination, client engagement, or consulting projects involving multiple organizations and technical subject matter experts.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Ability to synthesize technical, regulatory, operational, and market information into actionable recommendations for clients and stakeholders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to conduct interviews, facilitate discussions, and engage with industry, government, and airport stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification or the ability to obtain certification within six months of hire.
* Experience with airport planning, airport development, Airport Layout Plans (ALPs), aviation infrastructure, or FAA\-related p

jobs.title: Media Buyer — Paid Social & Search
jobs.description:
At Peak 21, we acquire and operate high\-performing direct\-to\-consumer brands across the US, Europe, and beyond. Our portfolio generates over $200M in sales — bootstrapped, profitable, and built for the long term. We don't just buy brands; we scale them.


We're looking for a **Media Buyer** to join one of our portfolio brands: a beloved D2C baby essentials brand with strong recognition across the US and Europe, currently doing **$24M in revenue last year** (roughly 50% Shopify/DTC, balance wholesale \+ Amazon) and growing fast.  

  

**The Opportunity: $24M $75M in 4 Years**  

  

This is not a maintenance role. We want to double the Shopify channel year\-over\-year while driving the overall business to $75M revenue by Year 4\. We're scaling paid channels aggressively (Meta, Google, TikTok) and we need someone who can move fast, thinks in systems, and knows what it takes to spend efficiently at scale for a D2C brand.


Paid media is the engine of this brand's DTC growth. . You'll have real ownership over a meaningful paid budget, work directly with a creative team producing scroll\-stopping content, and be a core part of the growth engine driving us from $24M to $75M. The person who owns it well will naturally grow into owning more: strategy, creative direction, offers, the funnel end\-to\-end.  

  

**Why This Role Stands Out**


Most media buying roles promise "ownership" and then hand you a fixed budget and a reporting template. This one actually delivers on the things ambitious operators care about:

* **Real budget, real decisions, real stakes** — You're not executing someone else's strategy. You'll have meaningful spend to manage, the latitude to test, and the trust to make calls.
* **Direct access to operators who know how to scale** — You'll work closely with Peak 21's founders and have access to mentorship from people who have built D2C brands at scale.
* **Front\-row seat to the full growth playbook** — You'll be the driver behind paid strategy, creative concepting, offer construction, and landing page optimisation — and see how it all connects. The best media buyers who come through Peak 21 learn to own all of it.
* **7\-figure upside \+ guaranteed next chapter** — High performance here can lead to serious personal financial outcomes. Peak 21 alumni have already gone on to build incredible companies — this is your on\-ramp.


If you're a media buyer who wants to go beyond the ads manager and understand how category\-defining D2C brands are actually built, this is for you.**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Be the **PPC master** — own, execute and **scale** paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, and emerging channels profitably from launch through optimisation.
* Be the **creative strategist savant** — lead concepting, briefing, and iteration on thumb\-stopping ads and variations. You understand what stops the scroll and converts, and you can articulate that clearly to a creative team.
* Run structured experimentation: creative tests, offer tests, audience tests, landing page tests — and double down on what works.
* Own the numbers: ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, AOV, contribution margin. You turn data into clear stories and decisions.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with ops, creative production, email/SMS, and wholesale teams while maintaining full ownership of paid media performance.
* Stay sharp on platform changes, algorithm shifts, and emerging trends — and bring those learnings to the team proactively.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **3\+ years of paid, hands\-on experience** in growth/performance marketing or e\-commerce for D2C brands. We will make exceptions for people without the exact years if you have proven results running ads, landing pages, and offers at a high level.
* **AI native** \- you use AI as a daily force multiplier — generating and editing creative, drafting and iterating copy, spinning up landing pages, automating reporting and workflows.
* You are a **doer** not a delegator.
* A **creative strategist** \+ **PPC master**. You don’t just “manage ads” — you craft strategy and creative that moves the needle dramatically. You can brief a great ad, give useful feedback, and spot a winning angle before the data confirms it.
* **You love the game:** the strategy, the creativity, the data, the psychology, the wins, and the lessons from the losses.
* Obsessed with profitable growth and the full customer journey. You think in systems and loops, not just campaigns.
* Low ego, high output, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity and ownership.
* Excellent at articulating ideas, learnings, and results — both in writing and verbally.
* This role is fully remote. You'll collaborate cross\-timezones, so some flexibility to overlap with those hours is appreciated.

**Bonus Points (not required)**

* Experience scaling a brand through the $5M–$30M\+ range.
* Shopify and Klaviyo experience.
* Familiarity with the parent/baby category.
* You've run your own paid campaigns for a side project or personal brand.


We take applications seriously and read everything. Generic applications get ignored.  

  

If you have a portfolio, ad examples, landing pages you’ve built, or case studies — please share links or attachments. We want to see your work.  

  

We’re looking for people who love the game and can think and communicate at a high level. Show us how you think.  

  

This is a rare seat at the table. If you’re the operator who wants to help build something meaningful, get world\-class mentorship, make real money, and set yourself up for your own future success — we want to hear from you.  




KEJG5Ps9G6

We're a US\-based integrated digital marketing agency (Boston \+ Nashville, distributed team) looking for a TikTok Ads practitioner to run accounts alongside our paid media team. To be clear about what this is: we want someone who lives in TikTok Ads Manager daily, not a strategist who hands off to someone else. You'll be in the account building campaigns, reading performance, and making the calls.

* Attend select internal Agency weekly calls

You're a fit if you have:

* Strong written communication. You'll work async with our team

Nice to have:  
Shopify or WooCommerce catalog experience, TikTok Shop, experience sourcing creators, experience with Triple Whale

Pay: $40\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour

Your expertise in media buying, campaign management, and analytics will drive the success of our marketing initiatives. * Excellent negotiation skills with the ability to secure favorable purchasing terms for ad placements.

Join us as a Media Buyer and become a vital part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to delivering impactful digital marketing campaigns that drive measurable results!

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

new_jobs.title: Media Buyer — Paid Social & Search
new_jobs.description:
At Peak 21, we acquire and operate high\-performing direct\-to\-consumer brands across the US, Europe, and beyond. Our portfolio generates over $200M in sales — bootstrapped, profitable, and built for the long term. We don't just buy brands; we scale them.


We're looking for a **Media Buyer** to join one of our portfolio brands: a beloved D2C baby essentials brand with strong recognition across the US and Europe, currently doing **$24M in revenue last year** (roughly 50% Shopify/DTC, balance wholesale \+ Amazon) and growing fast.  

  

**The Opportunity: $24M $75M in 4 Years**  

  

This is not a maintenance role. We want to double the Shopify channel year\-over\-year while driving the overall business to $75M revenue by Year 4\. We're scaling paid channels aggressively (Meta, Google, TikTok) and we need someone who can move fast, thinks in systems, and knows what it takes to spend efficiently at scale for a D2C brand.


Paid media is the engine of this brand's DTC growth. . You'll have real ownership over a meaningful paid budget, work directly with a creative team producing scroll\-stopping content, and be a core part of the growth engine driving us from $24M to $75M. The person who owns it well will naturally grow into owning more: strategy, creative direction, offers, the funnel end\-to\-end.  

  

**Why This Role Stands Out**


Most media buying roles promise "ownership" and then hand you a fixed budget and a reporting template. This one actually delivers on the things ambitious operators care about:

* **Real budget, real decisions, real stakes** — You're not executing someone else's strategy. You'll have meaningful spend to manage, the latitude to test, and the trust to make calls.
* **Direct access to operators who know how to scale** — You'll work closely with Peak 21's founders and have access to mentorship from people who have built D2C brands at scale.
* **Front\-row seat to the full growth playbook** — You'll be the driver behind paid strategy, creative concepting, offer construction, and landing page optimisation — and see how it all connects. The best media buyers who come through Peak 21 learn to own all of it.
* **7\-figure upside \+ guaranteed next chapter** — High performance here can lead to serious personal financial outcomes. Peak 21 alumni have already gone on to build incredible companies — this is your on\-ramp.


If you're a media buyer who wants to go beyond the ads manager and understand how category\-defining D2C brands are actually built, this is for you.**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Be the **PPC master** — own, execute and **scale** paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, and emerging channels profitably from launch through optimisation.
* Be the **creative strategist savant** — lead concepting, briefing, and iteration on thumb\-stopping ads and variations. You understand what stops the scroll and converts, and you can articulate that clearly to a creative team.
* Run structured experimentation: creative tests, offer tests, audience tests, landing page tests — and double down on what works.
* Own the numbers: ROAS, CAC, LTV, conversion rate, AOV, contribution margin. You turn data into clear stories and decisions.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with ops, creative production, email/SMS, and wholesale teams while maintaining full ownership of paid media performance.
* Stay sharp on platform changes, algorithm shifts, and emerging trends — and bring those learnings to the team proactively.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **3\+ years of paid, hands\-on experience** in growth/performance marketing or e\-commerce for D2C brands. We will make exceptions for people without the exact years if you have proven results running ads, landing pages, and offers at a high level.
* **AI native** \- you use AI as a daily force multiplier — generating and editing creative, drafting and iterating copy, spinning up landing pages, automating reporting and workflows.
* You are a **doer** not a delegator.
* A **creative strategist** \+ **PPC master**. You don’t just “manage ads” — you craft strategy and creative that moves the needle dramatically. You can brief a great ad, give useful feedback, and spot a winning angle before the data confirms it.
* **You love the game:** the strategy, the creativity, the data, the psychology, the wins, and the lessons from the losses.
* Obsessed with profitable growth and the full customer journey. You think in systems and loops, not just campaigns.
* Low ego, high output, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity and ownership.
* Excellent at articulating ideas, learnings, and results — both in writing and verbally.
* This role is fully remote. You'll collaborate cross\-timezones, so some flexibility to overlap with those hours is appreciated.

**Bonus Points (not required)**

* Experience scaling a brand through the $5M–$30M\+ range.
* Shopify and Klaviyo experience.
* Familiarity with the parent/baby category.
* You've run your own paid campaigns for a side project or personal brand.


We take applications seriously and read everything. Generic applications get ignored.  

  

If you have a portfolio, ad examples, landing pages you’ve built, or case studies — please share links or attachments. We want to see your work.  

  

We’re looking for people who love the game and can think and communicate at a high level. Show us how you think.  

  

This is a rare seat at the table. If you’re the operator who wants to help build something meaningful, get world\-class mentorship, make real money, and set yourself up for your own future success — we want to hear from you.
